The *Mittātherīgāthā* (Thig 1.8) is an early Buddhist poem preserved in the *Therīgāthā* ("Verses of the Senior Nuns") within the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. It constitutes the verse utterance attributed to the elder nun (*therī*) Mittā. The SuttaCentral database records thirteen modern translations of the text across ten languages, including English translations by Bhikkhu Sujato and Ayya Soma [SuttaCentral].
